title: Evaluation of a realistic training model for hysteroscopic myomectomies
summary: Minimally invasive surgery has become an integral part of gynecology. In order to train prospective or aspiring gynecological surgeons and to make this efficient and safe in everyday clinical practice, it is important to be able to offer suitable training models for demanding surgical procedures. Therefore, in this study, a uterine model with a myoma reaching into the uterine cavity will be tested for its realism in a hysteroscopic (minimally invasive surgery via a camera through the cervical canal) surgical simulation. Experienced and inexperienced surgeons will be compared for this type of procedure. Physicians from the Department of Gynecology and Obstetrics at the Mainz University Medical Center can participate.

interventions.name: The participant with expert status (10 or more independently performed hysteroscopic myomectomies) is presented with an example video for hysteroscopic myomectomy. The procedure is then performed on a model in a training center for minimally invasive surgery.

The participant with beginner status (9 or fewer independently performed hysteroscopic myomectomies) is presented with an example video for hysteroscopic myomectomy. The procedure is then performed on a model in a training center for minimally invasive surgery.
